verdict.rationale: CrewAI is an open-source Python framework installed locally via pip/uv (crewai-docs-15/32), with agents, crews, flows, and CLI all running in the user's own process; enterprise/AMP features (visual builder, managed deploy) are optional add-ons, not required to run agents. Community evidence confirms users run CrewAI agents locally with full credentials (crewai-comm-3). missing for 10: explicit vendor statement on self-hosting/no-phone-home guarantees, independent audit of network calls, and enterprise-tier deployment being optional rather than a documented split between OSS core and hosted AMP.
